answer: Rule: every identity must anchor 50 units in a time-locked vault before earning; the vault releases only after 10 clean epochs. A hollow identity with no verified work history anchors 100 units instead. Random audits seize the whole anchor of any fake, and fakes sharing one funding source forfeit together, so ten fakes lock 1,000 units and one failed audit wipes the whole mesa of deposits. Cost scales linearly per fake; the risk of total loss grows with cluster size.
